buildCommand: node -e "if (process.env.DATABASE_URL && process.env.DATABASE_URL.startsWith('postgres')) { require('child_process').execSync('prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.postgres.prisma && prisma db push --schema prisma/schema.postgres.prisma --skip-generate && npx tsx prisma/seed.ts', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } else { require('child_process').execSync('prisma generate', { stdio: 'inherit' }); }" && next build
